title: Our Automation Stopped Backing Up for Three Days. Nothing Told Us.
description: Our blog automation said done every morning while its GitHub backup failed for three days. What broke, and the result check that catches it.
ogDescription: A real automation that failed quietly for three days, and the one habit that catches it: check the result, not the status.
alt: Git log of 16 commits that never reached GitHub, July 14 to July 17
ctaLine: Check the result, not the status.
